title: Student V0.1 served-session V4 integration rework
purpose: Wire the already-qualified Student V0.1 V4 Learning/presentation seams into the real served learner session path so an imported rich V4 course can start, render, respond, reload/resume and complete without leaking scoring secrets or changing the frozen contract.
invariants: The frozen learnit.kit.v4 contract and Wave 1 interface freeze remain authority; this repair changes integration only.
Core Learning/session remains the sole sequencing, evaluation, completion and persistence authority.
The served UI must receive learner-safe ActivityPresentation data, not authored scoring secrets.
The existing generic projectActivityPresentation(), renderActivityPresentation() and readActivityResponse() implementations are reused unchanged.
The real classic served path must support all eight V4 families through the generic presenter seam.
Lesson and flashcard responses advance completion only and must never become correctness, mastery, validation, transfer or spaced-review evidence.

Atlas Today may remain intentionally bounded to qcm/fill-compatible assessed courses, but its compatibility gate must explicitly encode what that path supports instead of accidentally requiring fields forbidden on non-scored V4 units.
A rich V4 course that Atlas does not support must remain fully usable through the classic served course path.
No sibling Wave 2 branch output is consumed; JOB06 remains frozen and untouched.
No new persistence schema, backend, plugin runtime, remote dependency or automatic migration is introduced.
requiredEvidence: Fresh Human Control Plane and repository/PR #402 rebind before mutation.
Independent reproduction of JOB05/JOB07 served-path blockers from exact base source.
Design note inside qualification evidence choosing the minimum coherent served path before coding.
Runtime-to-UI projection proves current and next activity payloads contain no correctChoiceId, answers, acceptedResponses, matches, correctOrder or classify assignments.
Existing frozen fixture apps/learnit-next/tests/fixtures/student_v01_v4_runtime.json is used for the primary all-eight-family served journey; no sibling Wave 2 fixture is required.
Real built application import/start/respond/feedback/reload/resume/completion is exercised through browser-visible controls.
All eight activity families are reached through the real served path.
Lesson/flashcard non-scored semantics are proven in the real served path.
Safe embedded media renders; unsafe/remote media remains fail-closed through existing validators/rendering boundaries.
Desktop 1365x768 and mobile 390x844 browser paths pass.
V2 and V3 behavior/regressions remain green.
Atlas qcm/fill route remains green for its supported legacy/current scope.
Existing Wave 1/R3 role suites and unchanged FAN-IN A oracle pass.
Source manifest is rebound only for changed declared build sources and its self-hash is valid.
Canonical deterministic build is executed twice on the exact final executable head with identical artifact bytes/hash.
Repository governance, PR scope and exact routed integration CI pass on the exact executable head.
Qualification evidence separates executable RESULT_SHA from later evidence-only EVIDENCE_HEAD.
adversarialTests: Routing every non-qcm activity to fill is a hard failure.
Passing raw canonical activity objects containing scoring secrets into renderApp or generic presenters is a hard failure.
Adding correct answers to ActivityPresentation to simplify rendering is a hard failure.
Treating lesson/flashcard completion as correct=true or as validation/mastery evidence is a hard failure.
Making lesson/flashcard Atlas-compatible by adding forbidden assessmentRole fields is a hard failure.
Silently upgrading Atlas session.js outside scope is a hard failure.
Disabling Atlas globally or breaking existing qcm/fill Atlas behavior merely to force rich V4 into classic mode is a hard failure.
Changing the existing generic projection/presenter implementations to accommodate served wiring is a scope failure; any actual defect there returns HOLD.
Changing the showcase kit or consuming JOB05/JOB07 branch files is a scope failure.
A seam-level test without real served-browser import/start/resume/completion cannot qualify PASS.
nonGoals: Authoring or reviewing the showcase kit.
Merging to main or launching JOB08.
independentReview: JOB05 and JOB07 independently exposed the same served-session contradiction from separate Wave 2 branches.
This repair must re-derive the blocker from exact base code before implementation rather than trusting their prose.
The final candidate must be challenged by exact-head browser CI and by unchanged prior regression suites.
JOB05 R1 and JOB07 R1 remain separate future contradictory reviewers and are not folded into this implementation job.
rollback: Close the repair PR and delete student-v01/served-v4-integration. The qualified R3 product/evidence heads and all three Wave 2 branches remain independently recoverable.
